rule: A mutant counts as caught only when its suite reaches the baseline check count and at least one check fails; a bash mutant also passes bash -n. Each mutant runs in its own copy of the files the suites read; targetFailed says whether the check the mutant was written for is among the failures.
baselineNote: Baselines are the GREEN runs at the measured commit, the two suites run side by side.
loadNote: Three PowerShell mutants ran at a time, then two bash mutants at a time, on one machine; seconds are wall times under that load. Bash mutants 15 and 16 first ran while the machine slept for four hours, were stopped by the runner's time limit without a result, and ran again; each row keeps the last run.

mutants.label: R5 a non-ASCII name whose one same-length candidate differs in case is that group: its id is recorded as pre-existing, nothing is created
mutants.name: names compared exactly, case and all (no length rule)

mutants.label: R5 longer names that start with a non-ASCII name, the name in another normalization form among them, are not that group: created once
mutants.name: a longer name counts as the name

mutants.label: R5 two same-length candidates for a non-ASCII name refuse on one line naming both ids, and create nothing
mutants.name: two same-length groups read as the first
mutants.mutation: 'if ($same.Count -gt 1) { return (& $result 'inconclusive' '' "$($same.Count) groups have a name of that length: $($ids -join ', ')") }' -> 'if ($same.Count -gt 1) { return (& $result 'present' $ids[0] '') }'

mutants.label: R5 an astral-plane name counts code points as jq does: the one candidate with as many code points is recorded, nothing is created
mutants.name: length in UTF-16 code units

mutants.label: R5 a resume that names a group in another case than its receipt does not use the receipt: the name is looked up, reused and not created
mutants.name: receipt name matched with -eq (ignoring case)

mutants.label: R5 bash a non-ASCII name whose one same-length candidate differs in case is that group: its id is recorded as pre-existing, nothing is created
mutants.name: names compared exactly, case and all (no length rule)

mutants.label: R5 bash longer names that start with a non-ASCII name, the name in another normalization form among them, are not that group: created once
mutants.name: a longer name counts as the name

mutants.label: R5 bash two same-length candidates for a non-ASCII name refuse on one line naming both ids, and create nothing
mutants.name: two same-length groups read as the first
mutants.mutation: 'if length > 1 then "inconclusive \(length) groups have a name of that length: \($ids | join(", "))"' -> 'if length > 1 then "present \($ids[0])"'

mutants.label: R5 bash an astral-plane name counts code points as PowerShell does: the one candidate with as many code points is recorded, nothing is created
mutants.name: length in UTF-8 bytes

mutants.label: R5 bash a resume that names a group in another case than its receipt does not use the receipt: the name is looked up, reused and not created
